detail_text: This special notice is for an Industry Day notification for the Jet Engine Noise Suppressors including Fire Suppression Systems Repair & Installation (Hush House). Please see the information regarding Industry Day below: Date: 27 May 2026 Time: 0930-1600 Venue: Georgia VECTR Center (Veterans Education Career Transition Resource) Center 1001 S Armed Forces Blvd, Warner Robins, GA 31088 **or** Virtual option may be provided via Microsoft Teams (meeting link will be sent based on expressed interest) *Briefing materials will be posted in the near future and breakout sessions will be scheduled upon receipt of your RSVP.
